notes: v2.25.0 — Reports aur Backup: Reports page se ab kisi bhi profile ya Page ki mukammal report screen par dekhein aur Print/PDF save karein (asal mehfooz data se). Nayi Backup & Restore screen: poori app ka full backup ek file mein download karein aur zaroorat paray to restore karein — restore se pehle mojooda data ki safety copy khud ban jati hai. Full backup isi PC/isi install ke liye hota hai; Excel backup pehle ki tarah mojood hai.
